consistency_note: Train footage: a single 21.7 s dusk platform clip, so there is nothing to make consistent. Landmarks: 17867868, 2880734, 18212765 and 17562644 are all summer daytime under clear or sunny skies and could sit together after grading (18212765 is a flat log profile, 2880734 is heavily saturated). 6866696 has a blown white overcast sky and 1987380 is low-sun with Big Ben in scaffolding; both break the look. The dusk train clip matches none of the daytime landmarks.
sourcing_note: Hard. Ten searches returned exactly one clip that is verifiably a London train (856360). Every 'view from train window' result was generic and, once viewed, was another country (mountains, tropical Asia, South Asia, fog farmland) or unidentifiable. Clips Pexels tags 'London Underground' turned out to be Brooklyn (853874), Liverpool Merseyrail (7611836) and Liverpool Lime Street (1647125). No DLR, Overground, Elizabeth line, Thames rail-bridge or front-cab footage surfaced at all; DLR and tube-platform queries returned only photo pages. Landmark queries (Tower Bridge, Big Ben) work immediately and landmarks are plentiful. Tooling limits: fetch_pexels.sh could not resolve any id above roughly 20 million (10 of 30 London attempts UNRESOLVED), so every recent upload, including the one explicitly London-Underground-titled video, is unmeasured. The repo sheet.sh fails on this ffmpeg (pad smaller than input); a patched copy in the scratchpad was used and the repo file was not touched.
